name: llm-free-cascade
description: Cascade a chat completion across every free-tier LLM API you have a key for (Gemini, Groq, Cerebras, SambaNova, Mistral, OpenRouter, Together, DeepSeek, Cohere, Hugging Face, Cloudflare Workers AI, Z.ai, NVIDIA NIM, OpenCode Zen, Pollinations) with automatic multi-key rotation, provider cooldown, multi-turn messages, streaming, and a paid last-resort fallback.
author: Ram Chandra Giri
